action_items: No functional issues found in iteration 4. Everything green.

(Nitpick) The MapView marker popups bind HTML via bindPopup(`${m.label}...`) with no escaping – acceptable since all current label/sub come from backend-controlled or employee data, but if customer-provided fields (customer_name/customer_address) ever contain '<' this will render raw HTML. Consider lightweight escape before injection.
(Nitpick) Courier portal watchPosition posts /courier/location every 15s but on logout it only clears the watcher implicitly via effect cleanup – fine; no leak observed.

(Note) Nominatim is a public rate-limited service (~1 req/s). The first fetch of a never-seen address may return null; retry on next fetch works (used in tests via explicit retry loop). Consider documenting the dependency and a small backoff/pre-warm on order creation for production.
critical_code_review_comments: modules.py _render_invoice_pdf: PDF label uses 'ZAPLACONA/NIEZAPLACONA' and 'Faktura za uslugi' (ASCII, no Polish diacritics) because reportlab default font doesn't ship Polish glyphs out of the box. Correct choice for correctness, but if desired, embed a UTF-8 font (DejaVuSans) to show 'Zapłacona', 'Niezapłacona', 'za usługi'. Low priority.
modules.py _build_invoice loads SMS rows with .to_list(100000) – OK for current scale but should be aggregated via $group to keep memory bounded in production.
modules.py _GEO_CACHE is an in-process dict; multi-worker gunicorn will have per-worker caches. For MVP fine. For prod, back it with Mongo (geo already persisted on order.geo so hits via that path).

modules.py admin_generate_invoices POSTs then does find_one(..., id) to return strip_mongo – a tiny extra DB roundtrip per tenant; acceptable but could return the inv dict directly (already strip_mongo-safe since it was built in code).

Dispatch.jsx polls /courier/locations + /courier/deliveries every 10s. The deliveries endpoint re-geocodes any order lacking geo on every call – after cache warm it's a no-op, but on first call for a batch of fresh orders with distinct addresses it could issue a burst of Nominatim requests violating the 1 req/s policy. Consider sequential geocoding with sleep(1) in the enrich loop or client-side batching.

CourierPortal.jsx haversine uses origin=myPos (watchPosition). If GPS is denied, ordered falls back to raw list (correct) but then also hides numbered badges – good. Minor: when optimize=true and myPos exists but all deliveries lack geo, badges correctly 0 – verified.
